description: Search notes. Returns metadata plus totalNotes; page with offset/nextOffset. includeContent adds full bodies (page size capped at 25). To export a notebook: query "*", set notebookName + includeContent, and page until hasMore is false.

format.description: Body projection when includeContent is true: markdown (default), plain text, or raw ENML

includeContent.description: Include each note's full body in `content` (one API call per note). Supersedes includePreview.

includePreview.description: Include first ~300 chars of note content as a plain-text preview (one API call per note; ignored when includeContent is true)

maxResults.description: Maximum results per page (default: 20, max: 100; capped at 25 when includeContent is true)

query.description: Search query (Evernote search syntax supported). Use "*" to match all notes.

name: evernote_search_notes
title: Search notes
